$comment: Provenance for the PMTiles basemap archives a pack may name in pack.json `tiles` (sand-lry.18). Hand-maintained: the archives are built and uploaded by scripts/tiles-extract.sh outside CI, so nothing regenerates this file. The bboxes and the reasoning are ADR 0002; the names are mirrored by src/packs/schema/tiles.ts and held in step by src/engine/map/tiles.test.ts.
licence: OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL. The Protomaps daily planet build is a free artifact: copy it, never hotlink it.

statuses.uploaded: in the assets bucket; a pack that names it gets a basemap
statuses.planned: the extract is decided and not yet run — naming it is correct and draws no basemap until sand-lry.17 uploads it
statuses.retired: still in the bucket, no longer offered to packs

entries.name: central-europe-z10
entries.serves: the default: 1914, 1915, and every western-front pack. Stops at 24°E/56°N — short of Lemberg, Riga and Petrograd.

entries.name: world-z6
entries.serves: the atlas landing view; every Pacific crossing; the Russian Civil War's continental sweep. The one archive that survives the antimeridian.

entries.name: eastern-europe-z10
entries.serves: the Eastern Front 1914-17, the Russian Revolution and Civil War, and the Eastern Front 1941-45. Cuts off Baku and Arkhangelsk; world-z6 covers those.

entries.name: east-asia-z10
entries.serves: Mukden 1931, the Home Islands, Formosa, Korea and Okinawa at theatre scale, and the Russo-Japanese War.

entries.name: central-pacific-z10
entries.serves: the Gilberts, Marshalls, Carolines, Palaus, Marianas, Bonins and the Philippine Sea.

entries.name: sw-pacific-z10
entries.serves: Guadalcanal, the Slot, Rabaul, Bougainville, New Guinea and the Coral Sea.

entries.name: philippines-z10
entries.serves: Leyte Gulf, Surigao Strait, Cape Engaño, Luzon, Lingayen and Corregidor.

entries.name: oahu-z13
entries.serves: Pearl Harbor: Ford Island, Hickam, Wheeler, Kaneohe.

entries.name: guadalcanal-z13
entries.serves: Henderson Field, the Tenaru, Bloody Ridge, Savo.

entries.name: betio-z14
entries.serves: Tarawa: Betio, the pier, the reef, the lagoon.

entries.name: peleliu-z14
entries.serves: Peleliu: the Umurbrogol, the airfield, Angaur.

entries.name: iwo-jima-z14
entries.serves: Iwo Jima: Suribachi and the Motoyama airfields. OSM has a coastline and little else.

entries.name: okinawa-z13
entries.serves: the Hagushi beaches, Kadena, the Shuri line.

entries.name: port-arthur-z14
entries.serves: the siege of Port Arthur: 203 Metre Hill, the inner harbour.

entries.name: western-europe-z10
entries.serves: nothing: the original 1914 extract, superseded by central-europe-z10 (sand-pmz.6) because it stopped short of Tannenberg and Sarajevo. Kept in the bucket, not offered to packs.
